selection_rule: smallest prime greater than 937 with p mod 12 = 1 and positive noncuspidal X0(432) count
question: Do nonempty E-projection fibers at a prime with a rational degree-three kernel saturate the three B lifts at the modular degree 24?
source_policy: All 997 j-values; one representative per generic quadratic-twist pair; three j=0 sextic representatives and two j=1728 quartic representatives paired under quadratic twist; cyclic nonbacktracking 16- and 27-isogeny chains
source_gate: Paired chain count must equal the independently screened Hecke point count 1836 minus 36 rational cusps
projection_policy: Evaluate every noncuspidal chain with intermediate j-invariants, Frobenius-fixed quarter-shifts, exact twist, and all rational preimages of the dual 3-isogeny
projection_gate: One filtered coordinate point per shift, one Frobenius-fixed pair, one E output and exactly three rational B preimages per source; independent source, E/B equation, isogeny, and fiber audits
degree_bound: Each B fiber contains at most 24 rational source points; an E fiber of size 72 with three rational B preimages forces all three B fibers to contain 24 points
primary_outputs: B-image count forced by the degree bound, if any
interpretation_rule: Report partial bounds when projected fibers do not all saturate 72; do not select an arbitrary B lift from a three-point coset
